earlier_failures.observation: An earlier ordinary process was still running an old loaded debug dylib under the same development bundle ID as the UI-test app. CUA attachment timed out and the first test run inspected conflicting windows. The empty stale synthetic process was stopped.

A fresh ordinary window initially focused the sidebar and ignored immediate writing. window.initialFirstResponder is now the editor. Both native keyboard tests and direct ordinary-build inspection confirmed the correction.

Startup narrow-window overrides were not stable across AppKit presentation. The fixture now uses real resize gestures on straight window edges. A first attempt at the rounded corner did not hit the resize region; the final edge gestures passed in both appearances.
One intermediate run timed out synthesizing input. Its result was not counted as a pass. The final frozen candidate passed all seven native tests in one run.
VoiceOver.app inspection exceeded the requested 20-second timeout and returned after 715.835 seconds. No VoiceOver pass is claimed. System Settings showed the switch restored off.
